common_project_rule.support_source: Caller supplies a separately prepared clean DatasetPart; never implicitly use clean_val/test or split frozen arrays in place.
common_project_rule.support_size: Explicit actual count; both clean classes required, no silent oversampling or one-class fallback.
common_project_rule.positive_negative_counts: Count actual labels, persist both counts and total extra label budget in manifest.
common_project_rule.sampling_seed: If sampled externally, source description must identify its preparation recipe/seed; adapter does not randomly choose support or tune its size.
common_project_rule.shortage: Reject absent class/invalid IDs; obtain a new approved preparation instead of borrowing validation/test rows.
common_project_rule.identity: Stable global IDs required; pairwise disjointness and digests; duplicate/subject groups additionally audited when applicable.
common_project_rule.support_origin: external or carved_from_original_pool; carved requires original_role_counts for train/pu_val/clean_val/test/prior_estimation and their reductions must sum to the support sample count; train reduction presence must match support_removed_from_train.
common_project_rule.source_verification: support_source_verified/receipt; default is an unverified caller assertion. No official PULNS source was located, so paper-independent provenance is explicit.
common_project_rule.pool_effect: Record original/remaining/reduced counts for train/pu_val/clean_val/test/prior_estimation; external support declares zero reductions; no automatic repartition.
common_project_rule.support_artifact_status: not materialized; per-run caller must supply actual source, counts and verification scope; formal budget still requires approval.
common_project_rule.selection: terminal OA only on separate clean_val; source internal best selection also uses support
common_project_rule.training_view: OS engineering adaptation, not author gamma sampling replay or TS-OS calibration
